sinopsis.es: Shafi, de 4 años, y su hermana Somira, de 9, salen de un campamento Rohingya en Bangladesh en un peligroso viaje hacia Malasia para reunirse con su familia.
sinopsis.en: Four-year-old Shafi and his nine-year-old sister Somira leave a Rohingya refugee camp in Bangladesh on a perilous journey to Malaysia to reunite with their family.
